_comment: self-heal Phase 3B hardened 案B — reversible CT resize allowlist. Data, grown ONLY via PR review. self-heal-infra-apply.sh resizes a CT's memory/cores ONLY when the CT (logical devices.json key) is listed here, the target value is within [min,max], the change is an INCREASE (never a shrink — a shrink below live usage OOM-kills the workload, review blocker 1a), and the per-CT daily budget is not exhausted. Empty by default = fail-closed (nothing auto-resizes until an owner adds a CT via PR). rootfs is intentionally NOT resizable here (ZFS refquota non-reversibility). Apply runs under the non-admin pve-resize AWS profile + a scoped PVE token (docs/self-heal-phase3-security-review.md §B), never sh1admn.

_schema.ct_id: PVE CT id, for the terraform address + PVE per-CT ACL cross-check
_schema.min_memory_mb: floor (never resize below this; also blocks shrink below floor)
_schema.per_ct_daily_budget: max autonomous resizes per CT per UTC day (cooldown vs oversubscription, review 3d)
